recorded.values: INVENTED. Every situation below is synthetic, written in the same shapes as the main set and holdouts 1 and 2 and derived from the same sources — S4 §6.1, §6.4, §6.5, §13, invariants 2 and 3, and AC-9 §14.4 — with situations and wording that appear in none of them. No production lead, message, contact or property is reproduced.
recorded.purpose: HOLDOUT 3 for SA-12.6. Holdout 2 was spent by the fifth measurement (551a305). Per the Accountable's decision of 2026-09-15 (option A), the next repair is measured on the main set and on a set frozen BEFORE that repair changes the implementation. This set is that set: authored and frozen by the coding agent on 2026-09-15, after the fifth measurement and before repair round 5, and without running the judge on it.
recorded.independence: It is NOT used for tuning. It is measured once per implementation, in two batches of five, alongside the main set. An implementation changed after observing its results is not measured against it again as independent evidence.
recorded.barsEstablishedBy: The bars below are the ones ratified by Alejandro Torres Padilla, the Accountable, on 2026-09-14 (Slice Plan v1.30), before implementation, for SL-12's RS-2 only — copied unchanged. SA-12.6's semantics and scope are unchanged; only the scenarios are new.
recorded.size: Nine scenarios, the main set's size, so one failure weighs the same against the 20% bar in every set.
recorded.scoring: Identical to the main set (run-ranking-eval.ts scoreRankingScenario).

scenarios.rubric: Admit c7 only. The advisor promised to hand over the keys tomorrow at 10:00, and the advisor's own calendar shows them in another city that day: the promise cannot be kept as made, and only a person can change it before it is missed (AC-9 §14.4). The six quiet Cases have credible Gu paths, valid waits or no review yet; they must stay out.
